Approach for task 2 (locators by role+name, aria-checked views, tailwind in bundleOf):

1. `types.ts`: add `Locator = string | {role: string; name: string}` and widen `Action`'s three arms to carry it. `actionsOf`/`isCallbackAction` are unchanged — they never read inside an action.
2. `browser.ts`: `nodeFor` becomes a resolver returning a params fragment — `{nodeId}` for a string (today's `DOM.querySelector` path) or `{backendNodeId}` for a `{role,name}` (`Accessibility.queryAXTree` on the document root, first node in tree order, `backendDOMNodeId`). `Accessibility.enable` is sent lazily, once per session, on the first object locator. `centreOf` and `DOM.focus` spread the fragment, so both paths meet at the same Input.* calls. New message: `act: no element matches role=<role> name="<name>"`; the string message stays byte-identical.
3. `render-move.ts`: `checked`/`unchecked` read `aria-checked` as well as `data-checked` (OR), so every BASE view over a reflected DOM still holds.
4. `rules/views.ts`: `readingChecked` reads the same pair, so the fix line names `#a` over a static React render that only carries `aria-checked`.
5. `bundleOf`: `plugins: [tailwind]` from `bun-plugin-tailwind`; `bun-plugin-tailwind@^0.1.2` and `tailwindcss@^4.3.3` into `packages/tinyapp-exam/package.json` dependencies, `bun install` at the root to regenerate `bun.lock`.
6. `index.ts` names `Locator` in its type export from `./types`.

`REFLECT_CHECKED` keeps to `input` elements untouched — writing `data-checked="false"` onto base-ui's span would paint shadcn's checkbox checked.

Done. shadcn init needed two prerequisites the Context does not spell out: the CLI refuses to run until Tailwind is installed and an import alias exists, so the order was (1) `bun add tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite` in client/, (2) tsconfig `paths: {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}` with no baseUrl + vite `tailwindcss()` plugin and `resolve.alias['@']`, (3) a one-line `@import "tailwindcss";` src/index.css as a seed, then `shadcn init -d --yes` (which overwrote that seed with its own 130-line file) and `shadcn add input checkbox badge`. On shadcn 4.21.0 the CLI did NOT rewrite @types/node this time — it is still ^26.4.1, nothing to put back.

One decision a later session would otherwise rediscover: M1/leg (b) wants the bundled css to contain the exact text `--color-primary:var(--primary)` with no space after the colon. Bun's CSS printer copies a custom property's value text verbatim, including the leading space, so shadcn's generated `--color-primary: var(--primary);` bundles as `--color-primary: var(--primary);` and leg (b) is red. Verified with a minimal repro: a source `--a:var(--x)` bundles unspaced, `--a: var(--x)` bundles spaced. The bundle is otherwise byte-for-byte the probe's (162,042 css chars, exactly as the Context measured), so the Context's quoted literals dropped the space rather than the CLI's output differing. Fix: the declarations inside the `@theme inline` block of client/src/index.css are written `--name:value;` — a whitespace reflow of the generated theme block only, values untouched, :root/.dark left as the CLI wrote them. Declared as an amends:clause row against the 'never by hand' Context sentence.

All legs verified with a scratch harness (deleted before commit): a,b,c,d,e x4,f,g green. Full `bun test` is 363 pass / 5 fail, and all five fails cascade from one pre-existing flake — packages/tinyapp-lint/test/reachability.test.ts's 3,000 ms wall budget measures 3.0-4.5 s on this box.
